Desktop Director (ddir) 0.1.0 - Windows x64

Quick start:
  1) powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1
  2) open a NEW terminal, then:  ddir mode / ddir list --text / ddir selftest
  3) (optional) install agent prompt:  install.ps1 -WithPrompt

Files:
  ddir.exe      single binary, no runtime needed
  install.ps1   adds to PATH, creates ~/.ddir, sets mode
  AGENTS.m0.md  prompt pack for your coding agent (M0)
  LICENSE       MIT
